name: kill npcs or something testing
desc:
a game where you use a set of firearms and tools to fight npcs, police and military bases upon a round system. every round you earn "medals" which lets you buy more tools that expand your armory. each server is has its own map, and in private servers you may configure the server to break the game or whatever.

NOTE: This is the testing place, this place does NOT contain your DATA from the original game. The original game was called "kill npcs or something". If you want your data back from the original please make a post on the group.

DISCLAIMER: This game does not intend to replicate, condone, nor support any sensitive real-world event(s). This game is an arcade-like PvE shooter game, please take care to note that.

private servers give double the medals per round. many gun models in the game created by @Rialagg

the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/8617091

shutdown is *major* update.

enjoy.
